S78.01.note: The code cited at WebSettingsModal.tsx:243 is a per-feature capability-decision hook (useCapabilityDecision), not one resolver found by name.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat.
Open the model button at the bottom of the composer and switch between two models.
Compare which controls appear (for example the Reasoning effort button) with what Expected says.
S78.01.where: No single resolver screen. Its effect shows in the composer controls and in Settings toggles, for example the Reasoning effort button.

S78.02.note: Which models have reasoning comes from live catalogue data; the exact model list was not verified.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat.
Open the model picker from the model name button at the bottom of the composer and pick a reasoning-capable model.
Look for the Reasoning effort button in the composer footer.
Pick a model with no reasoning support and check that the Reasoning effort button is gone or changed, as Expected says.
S78.02.where: Composer > model button > choose a model with reasoning > Reasoning effort button beside the composer

S78.03.needs: a file to upload; a model on your plan that cannot read the file
S78.03.note: The composer's accepted-file rules are in ChatComposerNew.tsx; the exact file-type list per model was not traced.
steps: Open the plus menu in the composer and click Add photos & files.
Choose an image or a PDF from your computer.
Open the model picker and select a model that cannot read that file type.
Look for the warning that says the selected model can't read the attached file, and the Use Auto button, and compare with Expected.
S78.03.where: Composer > plus menu > Add photos & files, then the model picker

labels.text: Off is not supported by this model.

steps: Open a reasoning-capable model.
Click the Reasoning effort button in the composer footer.
Read the marks on the slider and the note under it.
Switch to another model, open the button again, and compare the marks with Expected.
S78.04.where: Composer > Reasoning effort button > slider popover

S78.06.needs: a paid account (video generation is gated by plan)
S78.06.note: Whether a Free account sees these controls was not verified.
steps: Open the plus menu and click Create video.
Open the Video model button.
Look at the Video aspect ratio, Video quality and Video length buttons in the composer.
Change the video model and check that the offered settings change, as Expected says.
S78.06.where: Composer > plus menu > Create video, then the video controls in the composer

S78.07.needs: a Free account and a paid account
S78.07.note: The server refusal on the session route is not visible to a person; only the UI state is.
steps: Sign in with a Free account and click Code in the sidebar.
Look for the notice Code is on paid plans and the Upgrade button.
Sign in with a paid account and check the Code page changes.
Compare with Expected; the server-side check cannot be seen from the screen.

S78.08.needs: a paid account with some usage (or a Free account)
S78.08.note: How the Settings window is opened was not traced in code; Usage is the settings nav item.
steps: Open the Settings window and click Usage.
Read the percent used bars and the note about the UTC calendar month.
Check the limit message, for example Limit reached, when a limit is used up.
Compare what is shown with the allowance shown elsewhere in Settings, as Expected says.

S78.09.needs: an admin account in a workspace and a second account in the same workspace
S78.09.note: The console page is also at /workspace/policy.
steps: Sign in as a workspace owner or admin and open Settings, then Workspace.
Click Workspace administration, then Policy.
Change a setting such as Zero data retention only and save.
Sign in as a member of the same workspace and check the restricted choice is limited, as Expected says.

S78.10.needs: an admin account and a member account in the same workspace
steps: Sign in as an owner or admin and open Settings, then Workspace; note the Transfer ownership button.
Sign in as a plain member of the same workspace and open Settings, then Workspace.
Check that owner and admin controls (such as Transfer ownership) are not shown.
Compare with Expected; the server refusal cannot be seen from the screen.

labels.text: Only use AI providers based in the US

S78.11.note: The label string is in apps/web/features/settings/components/UsOnlyRoutingPanel.tsx (const LABEL); the Privacy nav item is in packages/ui/ui/src/settings-nav.ts.
steps: Open Settings and click Privacy.
Turn on Only use AI providers based in the US.
Open the model picker and look for models that are marked unavailable.
Compare with Expected; the note says models without a US-based provider are unavailable.
S78.11.where: Settings > Privacy > Only use AI providers based in the US

S78.12.needs: a new account to sign up
S78.12.note: The ineligible wording is built from a template in packages/contracts/types/src/account-eligibility.ts, and the age input itself was not traced; the cited RecordTermsAcceptance.tsx lines moved.
steps: Start a new account on the sign-up page and reach the Confirm your age step.
Read the notice that says this service is for adults.
Complete the step with an age under 18 if the step offers that choice.
Check the screen that tells you that you must be at least 18 to continue, and compare with Expected.

S78.13.needs: an account where some connectors are not connected yet
S78.13.note: The route from the Plugins item to a plugin page was not traced; the plugin page URL is /plugins/<id>.
steps: Open a plugin that needs connectors from the Plugins item in the composer plus menu.
Scroll to Required connectors.
Look at each connector row: Checking, then Connected or a Connect link.
Compare with Expected.
S78.13.where: Plugins (composer plus menu) > a plugin page (/plugins/<id>) > Required connectors

S78.14.needs: a Desktop app signed in to the same account (to see online or offline status)
S78.14.note: The status text comes from apps/web/features/desktop-host/hooks/use-paired-desktop.ts; the exact trigger label of the Code more menu was not confirmed.
steps: Sign in on the web app and click Code in the sidebar.
Open the Code menu that holds Work with local code.
Hover or read the Desktop app row: the status says the paired desktop is online, asleep or offline.
Compare with Expected; with no paired desktop the row links to the download page.
S78.14.where: Code page > the Code more menu > Work with local code (Desktop app)

labels.text: Your plan does not include managed environments.

S78.15.needs: a Free account (to see the plan notice)
S78.15.note: Which of the two notices shows depends on the live deployment setting.
steps: Sign in and click Code in the sidebar.
If the deployment has managed environments off, read Managed environments are not enabled on this deployment.
If the plan does not include them, read Your plan does not include managed environments.
Compare with Expected; when the environment is being prepared the page says it is still being prepared.

S78.16.needs: none (a provider outage must be present for the Temporarily unavailable row)
S78.16.note: The Temporarily unavailable state depends on live provider status, so it may not appear in a normal test run.
steps: Open the model picker from the model name button in the composer.
Look for rows with Coming soon or Beta labels and rows marked Not available in this app.
Look for a row marked Temporarily unavailable.
Compare the wording: Temporarily unavailable means a temporary provider problem; Not available in this app means not offered here.

S78.17.needs: the Desktop app on a Mac, and the web app in a browser
S78.17.note: The rows appear only when the desktop host is present (ChatComposerNew.tsx sets showDesktopActionRows from desktopHost).
steps: In the web app, open the composer plus menu and note that Use the browser, Run a local command and Use this computer are not listed.
Open the same plus menu in the Desktop app.
Check that Use the browser appears there.
Compare with Expected.
S78.17.where: Composer > plus menu > Use the browser (Desktop app only)

S78.18.note: Locked rows read as '<plan> and above' built from a template; the exact plan label depends on the catalogue.
steps: Sign in with a Free account and open the model picker.
Find a row with a lock label such as an upgrade-plan label, or Coming soon.
Hover or click the locked row and read the reason.
Check the row stays visible and shows why it is locked, as Expected says.
S78.18.where: Composer > model button > Models picker > a locked row

steps: Sign in with a Free account and open the model picker.
Find a row marked Upgrade to use with a plan name.
Click the row or the link What each plan includes.
Check that the plan that unlocks it is named and the upgrade path is reachable, as Expected says.
S78.19.where: Composer > model button > Models picker > locked row > Upgrade to use, and the link What each plan includes

S78.20.needs: an outside account (such as Google or GitHub) to finish connecting
steps: Open a plugin that needs connectors.
Find a connector row that shows Connect.
Click Connect and confirm it opens the connectors page.
Compare with Expected: the connector to connect is named in the row and the link gives the way to connect.
S78.20.where: Plugins page for a plugin (/plugins/<id>) > Required connectors > Connect

S78.21.needs: the Desktop app; a Chrome extension paired for the browser text; a microphone for the Voice settings
S78.21.note: The dictation start error shows The microphone could not be started. Try again. (apps/web/features/chat/hooks/use-dictation.ts); no pre-permission explanation for the microphone was found.
steps: In the Desktop app, open the composer plus menu and click Use the browser.
Read the dialog text that says every action asks you first.
Open Settings > Voice and look at the Microphone choice.
Compare with Expected; no microphone permission explanation was found before the system prompt.
S78.21.where: Composer > plus menu > Use the browser (Desktop app)

S78.22.needs: an image file; a model on your plan that cannot read images
S78.22.note: The server-side refusal text for an unsupported feature is in apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts.
steps: Attach an image from Add photos & files.
Open the model picker and choose a model that cannot read images.
Read the warning that says the selected model can't read the attached image.
Check the Use Auto button and the Choose a compatible model button, and compare with Expected.
S78.22.where: Composer > plus menu > Add photos & files, then the model picker

S78.23.needs: a Desktop app signed in to the same account
S78.23.note: The session menu also has a Desktop app row (CodeSessionMenu.tsx); the trigger for the Code more menu was not confirmed.
steps: Sign in on the web app and open Code.
Open the Code menu that holds Work with local code, and choose the Desktop app row.
If the Desktop app is paired and online, check that the link opens the same work in Desktop.
Compare with Expected; there is no equivalent action in the chat composer.
S78.23.where: Code page > Work with local code (Desktop app)

S78.24.needs: a local model runtime (Ollama or LM Studio) for the On this device section; a workspace admin account for the Policy modes
S78.24.note: Only partly confirmed: the local choice is in the picker, but the own-key and cloud choice per message was not located. Settings > Models & Keys (packages/ui/ui/src/settings-nav.ts) may hold keys.
steps: Open the model picker and look for the section On this device.
Choose a local model there and send a message.
As a workspace admin, open Workspace administration > Policy and read the Local, Your own keys and Cloud modes.
Compare with Expected; a per-message choice between own key and managed cloud was not found.
S78.24.where: Composer > model button > On this device (local models); workspace owners set Your own keys and Cloud in Workspace administration > Policy

S78.25.needs: a file to upload; a model on your plan that cannot read it
steps: Attach an image or PDF.
Switch to a model that cannot read it.
Read the warning, then click Choose a compatible model or Use Auto.
Click Remove attachments on another try and check the file is removed, as Expected says.
S78.25.where: Composer > attach a file > switch model > attachment warning with Remove attachments and Choose a compatible model

S78.26.needs: a paid account (Fast mode is plan-dependent; not verified)
S78.26.note: The unsupported-parameter message comes from the server in request-processor.ts; the removal before sending is not visible on screen.
steps: Choose a model and open the Reasoning effort button.
Turn on the Fast mode switch.
Choose a model that does not offer Fast mode, and send a message.
Look for the message Fast mode is not available for that model, and check whether the option was removed before sending, as Expected says.
S78.26.where: Composer > Reasoning effort button > Fast mode switch

S78.28.needs: a Free account and a paid plan change it can make (Stripe checkout), in the same workspace
S78.28.note: The Code line cites ChatComposerNew.tsx:1067 and use-billing-queries.ts:108; the effect is inner behaviour (billing data is refetched with staleTime 0 and refetchOnWindowFocus true), so the tester only sees it through the controls above. The Desktop shell is Electron showing the hosted web app, so these are the same web screens. I did not confirm the plus button's visible label or the Desktop-only path for plan changes.
steps: Sign in with a Free account, open a chat, and open the composer's plus menu. Note whether the "Create image" and "Create video" rows appear, and whether the "Chat" / "Work" mode choice appears.
Open Settings > Billing and start a plan change (this opens a Stripe page; complete it or use a test plan change).
Return to the app window and bring it back into focus, without reloading or reinstalling.
Open the composer's plus menu again and check whether "Create image" and "Create video" now show, and whether "Work" is now selectable, matching the new plan.
S78.28.where: Live refresh of gated controls: the chat composer's Work mode and Create image / Create video rows update after a plan change, with no restart. The plan change is made in Settings > Billing.
